sections.heading: Purpose and controlled scope
sections.text: RegolithWorks 6.0 supports autonomy rehearsal. This baseline is limited to controlled ground-test use. Make abort behavior deterministic before expanding automated sequences. The specification controls the relationship between the accepted configuration, its inputs or test materials, and the verification evidence used for a development decision. It does not authorize flight qualification, asteroid resource certification, commercial mining, or mission approval. Hardware-in-the-loop results are not flight qualification.

sections.heading: Configuration, ownership, and dependencies
sections.text: Quinn Mercer owns the product scope; Sasha Linden owns verification. Teams shall register configuration and inputs, complete reference checks, execute the bounded campaign, and review evidence before accepting a subsequent configuration. Adoption requires approved input or test-material specification, named technical reviewer, configuration-controlled reference case. A dependency named below is part of the requirement boundary. Replacing that dependency without review would change the basis on which the acceptance result is interpreted.

sections.heading: RW-001 - Containment
sections.text:
The test cartridge shall remain closed throughout the collection sequence.

Acceptance: Inspect seal position before and after every run; any open state fails the run.

Verification method: mechanical inspection. Dependency: capture-cartridge. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Seal wear can invalidate collection evidence. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-002 - Pressure envelope
sections.text:
The chamber controller shall inhibit a sequence outside the approved pressure envelope.

Acceptance: Inject out-of-envelope pressure and observe inhibition before actuator enable.

Verification method: fault injection. Dependency: pressure-sensor. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: A failed sensor must not be interpreted as nominal pressure. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-003 - Thermal limit
sections.text:
The heater controller shall stop heating when the configured temperature limit is reached.

Acceptance: Command heating at the configured limit and verify shutdown within one control cycle.

Verification method: controller test. Dependency: temperature-sensor. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Temperature overshoot requires a documented disposition. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-004 - Power interlock
sections.text:
Actuator power shall require an independent enabled interlock.

Acceptance: Remove interlock permission and verify zero actuator-enable commands.

Verification method: electrical test. Dependency: power-interface. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Software permission alone is insufficient. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-005 - Emergency stop
sections.text:
An emergency-stop request shall supersede an active extraction command.

Acceptance: Issue emergency stop during each sequence state and verify a latched stop.

Verification method: state-transition test. Dependency: safety-controller. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Reset shall not resume the interrupted sequence. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-006 - Sample custody
sections.text:
Every sample container shall carry a unique identifier linked to its run.

Acceptance: Reconcile all collected containers to run identifiers with no duplicates.

Verification method: records audit. Dependency: custody-register. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Unidentified material is excluded from reported recovery. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-007 - Blank control
sections.text:
Each material campaign shall include an empty-cartridge blank run.

Acceptance: Verify blank-run completion and contamination disposition before material runs.

Verification method: campaign review. Dependency: chamber-cleaning. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: A contaminated blank invalidates subsequent interpretation. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-008 - Mass accounting
sections.text:
The run record shall include input, recovered, retained, and unaccounted mass.

Acceptance: Confirm the four quantities reconcile within the approved balance tolerance.

Verification method: balance reconciliation. Dependency: calibrated-balance. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Unaccounted mass is not recovered product. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-009 - Time synchronization
sections.text:
Controller and instrument events shall share a synchronized run clock.

Acceptance: Verify clock offset is no greater than 100 milliseconds in the acceptance run.

Verification method: timestamp comparison. Dependency: run-clock. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Misaligned events can reverse apparent causality. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-010 - Telemetry continuity
sections.text:
The controller shall flag any telemetry gap longer than two seconds.

Acceptance: Inject a three-second gap and verify a flagged run-quality event.

Verification method: communications test. Dependency: telemetry-recorder. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: A flagged gap requires review before accepting results. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-011 - Configuration control
sections.text:
The run header shall record controller, cartridge, and sensor revisions.

Acceptance: Verify complete revision fields on every accepted run.

Verification method: configuration audit. Dependency: revision-register. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Mixed revisions prevent comparable campaign results. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-012 - Calibration freshness
sections.text:
Mass and temperature measurements shall use current approved calibrations.

Acceptance: Reject an expired calibration during pre-run checks.

Verification method: negative test. Dependency: calibration-register. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Calibration drift can be mistaken for extraction improvement. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-013 - Recovery restart
sections.text:
Restart after an abort shall require a new pre-run checklist.

Acceptance: Attempt direct resume after abort and verify rejection.

Verification method: fault recovery test. Dependency: checklist-register. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: An interrupted run shall retain its original failed status. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-014 - Data export
sections.text:
Exported run data shall include units, channel names, and quality flags.

Acceptance: Reimport a completed run and compare all channel metadata and flags.

Verification method: round-trip test. Dependency: data-schema. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Numeric values without units are not acceptable evidence. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-015 - Operator authority
sections.text:
Only an authorized operator shall acknowledge a safety hold.

Acceptance: Attempt acknowledgment with a read-only account and verify denial.

Verification method: access-control test. Dependency: operator-register. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: A hold is not cleared by changing the view. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: RW-016 - Release evidence
sections.text:
A development release shall include a signed verification matrix.

Acceptance: Verify every requirement has a method, result, owner, and disposition.

Verification method: release review. Dependency: verification-matrix. Verification owner: Sasha Linden.

Disposition: Open critical failures block release to the next test campaign. The acceptance record shall identify the evaluated configuration and retain the observed outcome. An unsuccessful verification result is evidence requiring disposition, not permission to replace the criterion after the run. Closure belongs in the signed verification matrix before a development release advances to the next campaign.

sections.heading: Acceptance matrix and release gate
sections.text:
Each requirement above is a distinct testable control, not an optional checklist item. The verification matrix shall retain the requirement identifier, method, observed result, responsible reviewer, and discrepancy disposition. Critical discrepancies block progression. Ground-development release status and flight status remain separate throughout review. Any change requires reviewed evidence before it is incorporated into the next accepted configuration.

The current campaign risk is unsafe state transitions. Hardware-in-the-loop results are not flight qualification. The release gate accepts evidence for the defined ground scope only. It does not establish resource recoverability, mission approval, or a commercial output commitment. This distinction shall remain visible in the acceptance record and in technical communication about the release.
